notes.title: Update #13
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the price of weapons.
[*] Now after the game update the saved data should be loaded correctly. This should fix the problem with empty closed rooms. [b]To avoid further errors, resave the game after the upgrade.[/b]
[*] Corrections and improvements UI.
[/list]
[b]Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 2 new NPCs.
[*] Added 2 new rooms.
[/list]

notes.title: Update #7
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33002645/74e1f0d3cd00ba007c8818a8e342346e0a2369e7.png[/img]
Hello everyone!
The update is aimed at increasing dynamics in combat and maintaining the balance of the game.
[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Balanced all enemies. Phew! Now the enemies will move more than just stand and think.
[*] Reduced the time of roll in all melee weapons for 2 seconds, and ranged for 1 second.
[*] Play more aggressive! Reduced cooldowns of time skills by 50%.
[*] Increased healing after the death of enemies.
[*] The radius of skill  "Dome" has been reduced in 1.5 times.
[/list]
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the item could be picked up before it reached the ground.
[*] Fixed "hit zone" for spears.
[*] Ability "Blink". During use, the hero does not take damage.
[*] Fixed small bugs of enemies.
[/list]

Thank you for playing «Dead In Time»!  I hope you are enjoying the game.

notes.title: Update #6
notes.content:
Hello everyone! And here is a new update! ＼(＾▽＾)／
[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Some items and weapons are balanced.
[*] The optional bosses are balanced.
[/list]
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Reworked spirits in the forest. Now they are pursuing the hero in the form of fireflies.
[*] Added markers to minimap that indicate exits from the room.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player's marker was missing on the minimap.
[*] Fixed a bug when talking to NPC.
[*] Fixed a bug in the cave event.
[*] Improved save system.
[*] Now, if the joystick is disconnected while playing, you can control the character from the keyboard.
[*] Uniform distribution of chests for each world.
[*] Minor improvements and bug fixes.
[/list]
Thank you for playing «Dead In Time»!  I hope you are enjoying the game.

notes.title: Update #5
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I hope you had a good weekend!
[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased run speed with a staff.
[*] The "Armor of Time" has been redesigned. Now, in addition to absorbing damage, it also speeds up the hero's time.
[*] Removed unnecessary animation attacks from the staff.
[*] Slight balancing of some items.
[/list]
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Now it is possible to make a roll before the end of the attack animation.
[*] Fixed bug with inactive save button.
[*] Fixed a bug where lightning struck the hero in the building.
[*] Fixed a bug where the level of items and weapons lost after killing the boss.
[*] Fixed small bugs in the battle with the final boss.
[*] Fixed bug with saving of dropped items.
[*] Minor changes in some enemies.
[/list]

notes.title: Update #4
notes.content:
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed the position of worms that stood close to the wall and could not shoot.
[*] Added tutorial information.
[*] Now the tutorial hints are accompanied by graphic information.
[*] The algorithm for constructing levels has been improved.
[/list]
[b]Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 3 new rooms. Now the total number of rooms is [b]157[/b].
[/list]

notes.title: Update #3
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33002645/7a700b9392804dedb5ee3dd28563ee8b580e6e8e.png[/img]
Many thanks to everyone for playing and expressing their opinion. Special thanks to [b]Archtek_Apoclypse[/b] for useful and constructive feedback.
The update is aimed at speeding up and balancing the game process.

[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Increases the attack speed and damage of all melee weapons.
[*] Completely redesigned hit detection for melee weapons.
[*] Reduced the cooldown of most weapons.
[*] Changed the amount and percentage of blocking damage to all weapons.
[/list]
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Added tutorial information.
[/list]
[b]Content[/b]
[list]
[*] New item added.
[/list]

notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased healing after killing enemies.
[*] Strengthened the skill of time for spears and crossbows.
[*] The speed of shooting bows and crossbows is reduced by ~ 10%.
[*] Reduced the number of enemies in several rooms.
[*] Changed electric towers. Now you can see when they shoot.
[/list]
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Towers with crossbows no longer shoot after the hero's death.
[*] Added tutorial information.
[*] Fixed bugs when target is selected.
[*] Fixed a bug where it is impossible to open minimap.
[*] Fixed invisible walls.
[*] Fixed errors when loading saved data.
[*] Added description in some skills for time control.
[/list]
[b]Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new special enemy.
[*] Added three new rooms.
[/list]
